trigger_condition: metrics-delta JSONL has one truncated/corrupt line (crash mid-append)
guard_snippet: try { allDeltas = await metricsWriter.readAll(); } catch { allDeltas = []; }
potential_consequence: MetricsWriter.readAll() throws on JSON.parse, aborting the whole sendSessionEndMetrics call — not just token totals

trigger_condition: a Claude Desktop session ends via this poller instead of the CLI SessionEnd hook
guard_snippet: sum MetricsWriter(session.sessionId).readAll() tokens here too before sendSessionEnd(...)
potential_consequence: desktop-proxy-detected sessions never get input/output/cache token totals on session end, unlike hook.ts sessions

trigger_condition: plain `codemie analytics` (no --report) run against a large/long session history
guard_snippet: add a `--no-cost`/size-gated opt-out before unconditionally calling enrichCosts(rawSessions, ...)
potential_consequence: every default invocation now concurrently re-parses every native log file, regressing latency where previously only --report paid that cost

trigger_condition: `--export json` or `--export csv` after cost/activeDurationMs are computed
guard_snippet: merge costIndex/costSummary into the exported payload; add an Active Duration / Cost CSV column
potential_consequence: the new Est. Cost / per-session Cost values (and, for CSV, activeDurationMs) shown in console/report are silently absent from exported files

trigger_condition: a SessionStart hook payload larger than the new 256KB scan budget precedes the marker line
guard_snippet: if (bytesRead === SCAN_BYTES) fall back to a full-file line scan before returning false
potential_consequence: sessions with an even larger hookAdditionalContext blob are still misreported as native-external — same bug this fix targets, at a higher threshold

trigger_condition: message.usage fields are non-numeric (string/NaN) from an untyped `any` transcript entry
guard_snippet: input: Number(usage.input_tokens) || 0 (and same for the other three fields)
potential_consequence: a string token count silently coerces `+=` into string concatenation in hook.ts's/aggregator's summation, corrupting all downstream totals
